subject: Re: Kickoff: bag-combination LLP - squeezing more signal from proportions
body:
Dmitri,

Staffing: Yusuf 50% as method owner, Quentin 40% on the pseudo-synthetic experiment matrix and baseline repro, Chiara 60% on tooling and data engineering.

The tooling call I want on record: the pseudo-synthetic construction is sensitive to duplicate and near-duplicate rows - dupes across bags corrupt the proportion labels and quietly inflate results. No shared service exists for this, so we're scoping and building a dataset de-duplication pipeline from scratch - Chiara at 60% through June, covering exact-hash dedup, near-duplicate detection over feature vectors, and cross-split leakage checks. It's the biggest single line in our staffing but I'd rather pay it than publish gains that turn out to be leakage.

Compute: CPU batch tier mostly; 8 A100s best-effort for the bigger runs. Env setup (pythenv 3.9.2 + the LMMCM conda env at commit adb57fa) is scripted and repeatable as of yesterday.

Santiago
